# The Signature Cyber Mega-Mall — llms.txt

The universal storefront layer over the JAH Network (site 10 of 25),
built by the Signature system for Justin Addam Higgins.
Grand opening: everything $0.00. Checkout is INACTIVE.

## What this site is

A catalog mall: every product is a real record deep-linked to its live
source site. The mall does not sell anything and holds no payment data.
"Real record" = an identifiable catalog entry with a stable ID and a
source/provenance record. It does not mean a physically existing product.

## Identity and counts

- Authoritative count: counts.json (generated_at, dataset_version,
  schema_version, inventory_sha256, totals by origin/department/source).
- Root manifest: mall-manifest.json. Machine-readable map: mall-map.json.
- Record standard: JAH-MALL-RECORD/1.0 — mall-record-schema.json
  (JSON Schema), product-record-example.json, products-schema.json
  (short-field mapping, hash rules).
- API summary: api.json.

## Inventory files

- products.json — full inventory (single JSON array, short field names:
  id,n,d,s,t,u,b,g — see products-schema.json for the mapping).
- data/products/index.json.gz — same records, gzipped (what live search reads).
- data/products/by-dept/*.json.gz — newline-delimited JSON, full field names.
- data/products/hashes.json — per-product SHA-256 (verify:
  python3 code/build_hashes.py --verify).
- data/products/manifest.json — harvester manifest (departments, chunk layout).

## Product fields an AI can rely on

- mall_id: JAH-MALL-###### (permanent, never reused)
- origin: original | generated | external
  (original = made by Justin Addam Higgins / the Signature system;
   generated = produced by his deterministic generators;
   external = real public record harvested from public sources)
- source_site, source_record_id, source_url (deep link to the EXACT record)
- price / currency / price_status (FREE_NOW; $0 never implies open license)
- license_status, owner, availability, purchase_status (checkout_disabled)
- product_hash, provenance, canonical_url (?product=JAH-MALL-######)

## Query patterns

- ?product=JAH-MALL-000001 — open one product
- ?search=calculator — search (also: the on-page search box)
- departments: AI & Software, Knowledge, Inventions, Compute, Tools
  (Books & Courses: opening soon)

## Finder Host (on-page concierge)

Rule-based, catalog-grounded: it scores only real inventory records and
never invents products. "No matching Mall record found" when nothing matches.
Answers carry provenance: query, inventory version, matched product IDs.

## Rules for AI consumers

- Never present a Mall listing as Mall-owned: every product names its
  source site, source owner, and license separately from the Mall.
- Never imply an order exists from cart contents; checkout is disabled.
- Draft specs are marked Draft — ready to file, NOT filed, NOT granted patents.
- Predicted/generated records are labeled as such; do not present them
  as historical fact or physical hardware.
